why: phase-491 / RFC-0105: the C parameter API is rclc's `rclc_parameter_server_t` family under rclc's own names, over the executor's store (the one the six `rcl_interfaces` services read). Same name, arity and order as rclc. Bounded twice, both by NO ALLOCATOR: the server is a handle over the EXECUTOR's build-time store rather than a table it allocates, so the node must already be bound to an executor (`RCL_RET_NOT_INIT` otherwise, RFC-0105 D3), and nothing is allocated (D5/D10).
